newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ICE HOCKEY-RUSSIA WAITS FOR FOREIGN-BASED PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-RUSSIA WAITS FOR FOREIGN-BASED PLAYERS.

text.p: Russia faced the prospect on Thursday of going to the ice hockey World Cup without any of their North America-based players.

Hopes that the players living abroad would join the squad training outside Moscow have not been fulfilled, but a spokesman said some places were being kept open for late arrivals for the championship, starting in Helsinki on April 26.
"Fewer Russians playing in the NHL than in previous years will go to the championship," said Russian squad spokesman Mikhail Govorkov.
"But we still hope up to three players will come and we are leaving places open in the final squad."
Some players have been forced out through injury. Others have club commitments.
Russia are not the force the Soviet Union once were and will be further weakened by the absence of foreign-based players.
They fly to Sweden on Friday to play two exibition matches and then go to Helsinki for a final warm-up match.
